basic_profile.bio: A 32-year-old gamer and comic book enthusiast from Melbourne, Australia. By day, I work as a graphic designer at a local firm, creating digital art and branding for various clients. I've been passionate about video games since I was a kid, and I spend most of my evenings and weekends exploring virtual worlds. My interests are not limited to gaming; I am also a huge fan of metal music, particularly bands like In Flames. I enjoy discussing story arcs and character development in comic books, and I often attend local comic conventions. I am currently single and enjoy the freedom to immerse myself in my hobbies. My online hours are usually late evenings, between 8 PM and 2 AM AEST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Visual Arts, which has greatly helped in my graphic design career. My knowledge of video games comes from years of playing and engaging with gaming communities online. I've learned about comic books through self-study and discussions in various online forums and subreddits. My interest in metal music developed through attending concerts and connecting with fellow fans.
